notes.title: Today's Patch - Small Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Ember's getting a small patch today.  Pushing 'F12' will no longer open the debug menu.  This should allow you to take screenshots normally as well.

A big thank you to the users that alerted me to the issue!
Let me know if anything else comes up. :)

Josh
